listing.name: Quake (Ironwail)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native Quake implementation with desktop packages. Limits: Distinct alternative to vkQuake, not another game; preserve per-implementation identity. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux native desktop packages/source builds, exact selected CPUs unknown in frozen evidence. macOS explicitly unsupported due to OpenGL4.3 requirements. Original data: Distinct alternative to vkQuake, not another game; preserve per-implementation identity. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
